items.title: Bill Gates pulls $818M from Berkshire to buy this giant
items.summary: The Gates Foundation Trust cut its Berkshire Hathaway stake while opening a new position in a home-improvement giant.

items.title: ‘The Odyssey’ Isn’t a One-Off for IMAX, Analyst Says. Plus, Dell and 3 More Stocks.
items.summary: While investors are focused on Dell Technologies’ artificial-intelligence compute segment, we think Dell’s storage portfolio remains underappreciated and should enable not just revenue but also profit acceleration.  As enterprises begin to repatriate workloads back on-premises, we think storage will see an uptick in demand, and notably, Dell could be unique in providing a more end-to-end AI offering....  3) Dell is shifting the portfolio away from lower-value third-party offerings and toward more Dell-controlled intellectual property, software-defined storage, and AI-relevant platforms....

items.title: The Toughest Questions HD Faced On Its Latest Call
items.summary: Home Depot's earnings beat looked great on paper, but analysts on the call kept circling one large one-time gain to see if the company's core profitability is really holding up.

items.title: Cramer Targets Stanley Black & Decker as the Pick-and-Shovel Play on Home Renovation Boom
items.summary: Jim Cramer sees Home Depot and Lowe's blowout quarters as a signal pointing straight at a supplier most investors are overlooking, but the numbers behind Stanley Black and Decker tell a more complicated story about whether this is a trade or something worth holding.

items.title: Bank of America resets Home Depot stock price forecast
items.summary: Home Depot is navigating a difficult housing market, but BofA sees several reasons the retailer could keep gaining ground.

items.title: Atlanta Falcons Agree to Sell 10% Stake: Report
items.summary: Investment firm Arctos Partners agrees to buy a minority stake in the Atlanta Falcons at a $10.6 billion valuation, CNBC reports.

items.title: 6 Big Takeaways From Retail’s Big Week of Earnings

items.title: Home Depot's Tariff Refund Never Made It To The Guide
items.summary: A one-off tariff refund is expected to be consumed by cost inflation the company had not planned for, which is why a quarter that beat on earnings left the full-year outlook untouched.
